steps.name: new meeting
steps.objective: A new encounter awaits you near the fighting arena in Elias.

lines.text: Adventurer going there~ Hello? Do you have a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A young girl’s voice calls out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pretty face… I don’t know this person.)
I've seen Adventurer fight in the arena-♬ Wow~ He's so strong, he's cool♥
I've been waiting for a strong Adventurer like you~ Would you like to have a cup of tea with me for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He seems like a strange person. Let’s leave quickly.)
Wait! for a moment!! Don't ignore it! It's not hunting?! I'm not even a miscellaneous merchant!
I came to meet you after hearing about it from Awen, %s!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (My steps stopped at the familiar name.)
Our Adventurer, we can't catch it all at once. Woohoo♥
Okay. okay. Enough joking. I'll tell you properly.
My name is Parmilla. I am the leader of the Oscuras mercenary group.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ah, that look. I'm used to it. A girl who looks so young and weak is the mercenary leader? You wondered, right?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's unfortunate, but it's true~

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Actually, I'm looking for a competent Adventurer for some reason.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Because I'm such a busy person, I've neglected my social life... Because no one knows much. (sniff)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I've heard your name quite a bit from Awen and Mr. Einst before~

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: And also from Ambrosia and Jade.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, Lena also talked about you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…the girl seems to be quite short-haired.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Anyway, after listening to him, I thought he was a pretty trustworthy person. From what I saw earlier, it seems like your skills are pretty good...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So that's it. Do you take any requests? If you're not busy, would you mind helping me?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I'd like to go into more detail...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: If you accept, I will move with you to the mysterious forest and we can finish talking.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: What do you think? Any thoughts?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I do?)

choices.text: 1. No, I have no intention of going together.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yeah? Too bad...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: If you change your mind at any time, please come to the inside of the mysterious forest.

choices.text: 2. Go to the mysterious forest with Parmilla.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes! I really like that cool attitude!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes! I really like that cool attitude! So let’s move right now. I'm going to warp, so hold on tight~

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This place…I came here with Mr. Platina before…)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Welcome to Mirgandia!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's still early days and there aren't many people around, but here... Oh, have you been here already? That's amazing. This is our first time on this expedition.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The Empire's wizards temporarily connected the Imperial Gate to the garrison where we were staying.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The only way to meet us is through that gate, so don't forget it.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: When I said “we,” I meant my mercenary group beyond the Imperial Gate.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Now I'm going to jump on this and go over to the other side... Before that…

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Do you have any questions?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I ask?)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's a request from the empire. The purpose is ‘Exploration of Mirgandia’

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Something that looks like there's something to be developed, a mysterious creature, or a relic - well, a treasure hunt?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I can't understand the thoughts of the nobles who spend a lot of money on things like this. There are so many other useful ways to use that amount of money.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Of course, I could kneel down and lick my shoes if I was getting paid this well for this level of work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmilla smiled with a cute expression that contradicted the content of the conversation.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Our kids? They are all kind, strong, good people.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Well, there are one or two idiots...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: They're idiots, so just ignore them.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: And… One of them…

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, no. Let's talk after meeting in person. Do I have to get along with everyone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think Parmilla's expression seemed dark for a moment... was it because of her mood?)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yeah. So shall we go now?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: If you go inside the Imperial Gate, you can go to our temporary camp. See you there.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: This is our temporary station. It may look a bit cluttered, but I had a hard time finding a useful place like this in this devastated area.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The Imperial Gate is connected directly to this side, so feel free to come anytime. Well then…

lines.speaker: 건장한 체격의 남자
lines.text: Leader, I have a moment to tell you...
lines.speakerName: a man with a strong physique

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ah, yes.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Sorry, %s. First of all, I'm looking around and chatting with the kids. I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: 건장한 체격의 남자
lines.text: … illustration.
lines.speakerName: a man with a strong physique

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The big man took Parmila with him. So, shall we take a quick look around?)

steps.name: Reason for invitation
steps.objective: Let’s find out why Parmilla called from Oscuras Temporary Garrison. (After entering the mysterious forest in Midgard, take the portal to the mercenary group's temporary camp.)

lines.speaker: 파리한 안색의 청년
lines.text: Ugh… ah… uh… Ah… uh…
lines.speakerName: A young man with a pale complexion

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s a young man with a bad complexion. It seems like he’s saying something, but I can’t understand it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I do?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I just decided to ignore it and pass by.)
Are you %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (When I hear a voice calling from behind, I turn around and see a young man with a bright expression standing there.)

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Hello! My name is Barmun. I heard from the manager that you were coming.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: The name of the black guy under his eyes is Gron. Currently, I am this guy’s mother… Ah, no. I am acting as a caregiver.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Gron's health has gotten a little worse since he came here.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: To what extent... are you slightly unable to recognize people's faces, slightly forget what people say, and have difficulty moving around on your own?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That doesn't seem like a bit?!)

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Anyway, please understand that I did not intentionally ignore Mr. %s.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Well, I've seen too much sunlight. Now let's go inside and lie down for a bit. Dark circles become darker.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Well, Mr. %s, please excuse me first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The young man supported Gron with a friendly smile and disappeared inside.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: … … You met Gron.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Sometimes Parmilla is standing behind me. Her expression looks gloomy.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s… I was going to wait until you got used to it, but... … .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The reason I called you here is because of that Gron.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: He wasn't like that from the beginning. It's just that I talk less and spend more time being blank... I thought I was homesick. I was originally a quiet person.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Then I gradually forgot what I was saying… At some point, it started to break down uncontrollably.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Now he can't do anything on his own.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Barmun is by my side taking good care of me, but... Now my body is starting to wear out more and more.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Our mercenary group's doctor says it looks like he's addicted to something...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Not only is he not doing anything special, but he also cooks and eats everything together.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: We sent other members to investigate the area where Gron was in charge of exploration, but there was nothing special.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That's why I called you here, %s.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I hope you find out why Gron became like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I can complete the quest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tried saying hello normally.)

lines.speaker: 파리한 안색의 청년
lines.text: Ugh… right… Boo…
lines.speakerName: A young man with a pale complexion

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seems the greeting didn't work!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The moment I raise my fist, thinking I’m going to hit him…)
Huh? What are you doing now??

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A bright-looking young man appeared and blocked the space.)
Oh, you are %s? I heard what the manager said.
But what is that clenched fist? Could it be that Mr. %s, you were such a bad person that you hit the patient?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Ah, the introduction is late. My name is Barmun.

steps.name: Find the cause
steps.objective: We need to find out why Gron became strange.

lines.text: 『Hidden Place』

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Once I entered the hidden entrance, a fairly spacious space appeared.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is here is a colorful magic circle of light and a strange object floating above it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s report it to Parmilla first.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I told Parmilla about the hidden area of the Quartz Cave.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: … Quartz cave? This is a place that other kids have looked at several times... … . We didn't find anything.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Anyway, this is not the time. Let’s go check it out quickly.
Wait a minute.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A young man with a sharp look blocks the way.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: … Calone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: As I have said several times, please call me Mr. Calone. Parmilla. Where are you going?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I heard from %s that something strange was discovered in the Quartz Cave. I just wanted to go check.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: As I have said this repeatedly, I have an obligation to report all your actions.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Of course, you also have an obligation to report to me if any special issues arise. Please refrain from acting alone without permission.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Did you say quartz cave? We will accompany you.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: … okay. Would it be okay if %s goes with it too? Mr. Calone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … … I don't feel like it, but I guess I can't help it since he has to guide me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmilla frowned at Calone’s words. She seemed offended.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Let's go, %s. Please guide me.

steps.name: Lee Hyung’s magic circle
steps.objective: After speaking with Parmilla, you must explore the depths of the Quartz Cave together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I returned to the inside of the cave where the strange magic circle was located with Parmilla and Calone.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: … What is that?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I feel like the energy isn't very good. Parmilla, let’s get out…

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Beautiful… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmilla passed by Calone, who was trying to dissuade her, and approached the magic circle and strange object as if possessed by something.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Parmilla!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone, look at this. This brilliance... It's really awesome.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: This must have some special power! Calone, we may have discovered something great!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmilla is walking around the magic circle, chatting away with a happy expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Calone, who doesn't respond, seems to be in a bad mood.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s! Calone! Don't be so far away, come closer and take a closer look. The work here is really cool~

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (At Parmilla’s urging, I approached the magic circle.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The magic wand floating in the middle is definitely beautiful, as Parmilla said...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I feel a bit of a creepy vibe.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (While I was preoccupied with the magic wand for a moment, I realized that I could not hear Parmilla's voice as she continued to chatter.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ooh...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Parmilla?! Come to your senses!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ugh… Boo…

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I thought it was a monster attack, but there was nothing around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It might be because of the magic circle. The moment I took out my weapon to destroy it, Calone, who was supporting Parmilla from behind, spoke.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Stop doing this nonsense. It's not something that can be handled easily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I can complete the quest.)

steps.name: magic circle investigation
steps.objective: After breaking the magic circle to obtain <Magic Wand Fragment>, you must complete the quest to Calone in "Deep in the Quartz Cave."

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … … What are you? How is this possible... … .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: No, it's nothing. Let's hurry and get her out of here.

steps.name: Piece of Magic Circle
steps.objective: After talking with Parmilla about the piece of the magic wand, go to [Pikman].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I asked if he was feeling okay.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yeah. It's okay~ I'm in debt. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Actually, my memory is hazy. I was looking at things in front of the magic circle... And then… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (After thinking for a moment, Parmilla frowned and shook her head.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: … Anyway, I'm sorry. You went through a lot of trouble because of me, right?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Let me first say thank you to Calone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … … Please call me Mr. Calone.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Well, that's enough. %s, Calone says you destroyed the magic circle? show me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He answered that only a very small piece had fallen off and handed the piece to Parmilla.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Umm… How on earth did you break it?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: But maybe because it’s small, I don’t feel the same strange feeling as in a cave.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Anyway, I don't know what this is, but it must have had an effect on him... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone. You are from the Empire. Where have you never seen anything like this before?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Looking at Calone, who spoke as if he knew something in the cave.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As soon as their eyes met, Calone immediately turned his gaze to Parmilla.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: No. And please call me Mr. Calone.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, really. a little! I guess I can see it clearly... … . Ugh. That's enough, that's enough. I'll ask my kids.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Then %s. Would you like to show this to the kids?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Anyone who might have knowledge about this strange thing...)

steps.name: Fragment Analysis(1)
steps.objective: You must collect 20 <Morning Dew Petals> from [Guardian Rose], [Guardian Dandelion], and [Guardian Hydrangea] in the "Jade Forest".

steps.name: Fragment Analysis(2)
steps.objective: You must collect 30 <Shadow Fragments> from the [Magic Soul], [Magic Resentment], and [Maturated Soul Fragment] in the "Quartz Cave".

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: What is this? What kind of piece is it? … Is that thing stuck in the corner a gem?

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: No, this is my first time seeing it. When it comes to jewels, I like Jubil. I'm not interested.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: The leader said you would find out if you ask me?

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: … The leader tends to overestimate me sometimes.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Umm… I still don't know. Just ask Pickman about this.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: I think he would know because he is well versed in all kinds of strange knowledge.

steps.name: Fragment Analysis(3)
steps.objective: You must collect 20 <Dragon Wing Powder> from [Hieva Mariposa], [Viento Mariposa], and [Laguna Mariposa] in the "Jade Forest".

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: What's going on? %s.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: … The leader told you to show this to me?

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Of course, no one in this mercenary group knows more about gems than me. Please give it somewhere.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: … This workmanship feels similar to that of the Empire.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: But this color and reflection angle... A swirling glow... something like this... It's my first time seeing you.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: As I look at it like this, I feel like this child is calling me.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Very beautiful... It feels somewhat uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: … Where on earth did this piece come from?

steps.name: Is the cure complete?
steps.objective: You must feed the finished medicine to Gron.

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Huh? What's going on?

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: What is it? That rock. Strange thing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He explained what happened in the cave.)

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Woohyohohohohoho-!!! puzzle!! There is a mysterious scent!!!!

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Well, give me that! Let me analyze it!

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Hee hee, hee hee. dissection! Let’s dissect!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I can complete the quest.)

steps.name: Finding a breakthrough
steps.objective: Let's go back to the depths of the Quartz Cave.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So, peakman. Why did you ask everyone to gather like this?

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Hehehe. heartbreak. And dear comrades. And as a bonus, %s.

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: It's time to be thrilled by this Pikman's genius. Hahahaha.

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Ta-da~

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pikman raises the medicine bottle in his hand high and shows it in front of the people.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Clear liquid is sloshing around inside the bottle.)

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: This body has finally created a cure for Gron!!!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ?! How in this short time... … ?!

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: … What is that?

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Isn’t it made every day?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: That medicine that doesn't give any relief even if you take it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The members’ reaction was cold!)

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: This profit, profit. no!! No!!! Don't doubt this genius! That's what happens to anyone who hits the ground!!

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: But if you're a real genius...

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: profit. Shut that mouth!!!

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: After… Hehehe… Hehehe. I'm saying it's different this time. Phew.

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: I'm sure everyone has seen the stone pieces the leader brought. I analyzed this guy... .

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Judging from the letters slightly visible on the piece and the colors used here, I searched through all kinds of old books to see if it was an old magic from the empire. Tsk tsk tsk tsk tsk tsk tsk tsk tsk tsk tsk tsk tsk

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: But unexpectedly, this is similar to elf magic! Although it smells like human hands. Hahahaha-! … … Anyway, the biggest use of this magic is binding.

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Look here. Can you see the thoughts this sculpture exudes? You can't see it? It's very small, but does it exist? What I am saying is that this thought is attracting a lot of things around it. By force!

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: For example, something like the human soul? It was brought in and ripped from the center, making it weak! And destroy it. Quang! key… Kikikikik...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Just a peak~ The editorial is too long. So what's the point?

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: … … Please allow me to at least explain... Pugh…

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Anyway, this is a medicine that dispels the energy of those thoughts!!!

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: If Gron got hit by this guy, then this will definitely be effective~ Wow... Kyahahahaha! ruler! Young Barmun, hurry up and try feeding him!

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: … Can I trust this? … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Barmun started feeding Gron what was in the vial with a suspicious expression.)

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Since this is the work of this genius Pickman, it will be effective in no time. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Ugh… eww… right… …

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Ugh… Boo… Ugh… … … hundred…

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Gron, who had been tossing and turning for a while with a painful expression, raised his head.)

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Bar… door?

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Barmun… why… ? Oh... What is everyone doing here... Are you doing it?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: !!! That's it!!! Do you recognize me? That's it!!!

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Uh… Uh oh. Barmun. I can hear you well even without shouting.

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: That's it!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Barmun hugged Gron with an expression of emotion. His eyes seemed to have become moist, but he should pretend not to notice.)

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Huh? Why is this happening all of a sudden~?

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: You… You don’t remember a thing?

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Huh? … what… ah… oh!

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: That? That?! hey!!! Hey, why are you like this!!! Open your eyes!!!! That's it!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (With a small scream, Gron loses consciousness. Varmun shakes Gron's stretched body.)

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Oh my... Is it a side effect?

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Ooh...

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: That's it!!!

lines.speaker: 그론
lines.text: Ooh... ah… cadet…

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Oh my... Mr. Gron is as usual... And even spit… I think it's gotten worse.

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: I think I came back to my senses for a while. Is it a failure?

lines.speaker: 피크만
lines.text: Ugh... The combination was correct. Pyu… It seems like I'm held onto my thoughts more strongly than I thought. Hmm…

lines.speaker: 바르문
lines.text: Then there is no way for him to come back... ?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Is there a need for another breakthrough?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s. I'm sorry to keep asking you for favors, but could you help us just a little bit more?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It appears that the medicine will be of no use to Gron as long as the magic circle remains. I think we will have to come up with another solution.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I came back to the depths of the Quartz Cave thinking I might find another clue)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I ended up meeting a familiar face.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … Is it you again?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: This thing is really getting on my nerves.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I asked what they were doing.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: You don't know anything, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I looked and touched every corner of the magic circle and asked what they were doing.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … You have a bad personality.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I didn't do anything special. I came here because I thought I might be able to find a way to return Mr. Gron to his original state.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: What are you doing here? Did Parmila tell you to come here?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Anyway, that… Don't go near that magic circle. Even if you are not affected by that energy, it is not good to stay here for a long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is Calone not affected by the power of the magic circle?)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Well, I'm familiar with that, so if I just have a few know-hows, that artifact isn't that...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I made a mistake. yes? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: No? I don't know what that is... I have no idea?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … … I feel really resentful of Parmilla for calling you.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I also resent my careless mouth... …

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Okay. I'll tell you what you want to know.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Let's go outside first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I can complete the quest to Calone.)

steps.name: the truth of the matter
steps.objective: You must listen to Calone's story with Parmilla.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … I haven't liked you since I first met you. I thought it was because there was something special about it.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Maybe that premonition foresaw this moment.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: You might have guessed something too. I don't want to be misunderstood as speculation, so I'll tell the story myself.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I am originally affiliated with the Empire's second private magic research institute. There, I was responsible for leading and directing the researchers as the director.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: What we wanted to study was the dominance and control of human emotions using fear.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: The superhuman strength of humans that is unleashed when exposed to extreme fear. If only the emotion of fear can be eliminated in that state, wouldn't it be possible to control that power rationally...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … This was the content of our research.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: But the study faced limitations.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Human emotions have a threshold. At some point, people overcame their fear, and it was a different result than we wanted.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: What I picked up at that time was the thing in front of me, the Degos artifact.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: There is no need to explain to you how to obtain it. Do you know about the being called Degoth?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I answer?)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: If so, the story will be quick.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: That is something like a magical circuit that concentrates the demonic power of Degos.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: By analyzing that, we wanted to create an object that could continuously convey to humans the fear that a being beyond human can give.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: But it failed.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: The subject just lost consciousness in extreme fear and did not move through the mechanism we wanted.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … You might already be guessing it. That's probably the reason for his condition.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: While exploring the cave, you discovered the entrance, and while investigating, you were exposed to the power of the artifact.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: This is the first time I learned that the longer the influence of the artifact lasts, the more it becomes like that...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I don't know why I didn't tell anyone until it got to that point.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … What is that expression? Do I feel cruel?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: But I'm also confused.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: The study failed, and the project was terminated. I was sent here as if I was being demoted.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: But how did that artifact end up here? I don't really understand either.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Degos. Fallen monarch. One of the Lords of the Demon World and is also called the Incarnation of Fury. There are rumors that its basis is human, but there is no way to confirm that.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: It is said that it is a being with great magical power and is sealed somewhere on this earth, and that when the seal is released, it will bring about the end of this world.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Of course, I have never seen it with my own eyes...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Anyway, if my guess is right, that is clearly an artifact containing the power of Degos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmilla, who heard the whole story, seemed surprisingly calm.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So, you were ultimately trying to create a human weapon without emotions, right?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: No! It's a misunderstanding. We were purely trying to study the transcendent power hidden in humans, and we had no intention of exploiting that power!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Isn't that your opinion alone? Did everyone agree with that idea?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … of course… There were some who argued that all research should be practical, but...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Perhaps your master thought the same.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Anyway, in the end...your research was successful. Calone without you... … .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Probably so. I was quickly dispatched here shortly after reporting the failure, but looking at that, all I can say is that I did it after that.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: This is what was expected if our research was successful. How on earth… Rather, why should I be excluded from it... I really don't understand. I'm confused.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: … I don't understand even more that we Gron should be harmed by your selfish experiments.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … … I am sorry about that.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That's it. Because saying something to you won't change his condition.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … That's generous.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I feel sorry for you because it seems like you are a victim too.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Yes? … What does that mean... … ?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone, you look smart, but I guess you're not that smart.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … ?… … what?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Still not sure? You ended up being used and abandoned.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: A capable subordinate who knows all of his plans but opposes them. It must have seemed like a thorn in my eye.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wouldn’t it be a perfect place to test out a powerful weapon for the first time?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ?!… Well, like that... This is ridiculous.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: My, I... I was taken advantage of... That can't be... Tsk…

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Calone seems quite shocked.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Of course, it seems that we are also prepared as guinea pigs for that weapon... … .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: … For some reason, I thought the pay was good for no reason. Tsk…

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I asked Parmila what to do next.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Well, what should I do? My head is complicated too.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: For now, please keep it a secret from other members. I don't want to force things to be complicated. and…

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I especially don't want to see Varmun trying to kill Calone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmilla's tone of voice as she glances at Calone is quite cynical.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: !!! Tsk… Sorry, sorry. They say it's not what I did, but... We deeply apologize for causing any harm to the mercenaries...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Just words?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Well, we will contact your home country and increase your salary even more!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So, is that possible since it is a card that is thrown away in the first place? (sigh)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Ah… …

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone, you seem to be a lot dumber than you look.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That's not what I want from you. I don't want to get involved in your dirty behind-the-scenes work...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: What I want is the destruction of that artifact.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: If we kill the source that changed Gron, Gron will be cured with Fikman's medicine and will return to us. Am I wrong?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: That’s right… I think it is.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone, you know how to destroy that artifact, right? If you've been researching that, you would know.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Well, it's like I failed and got kicked out of the lab... That finished artifact wasn't even made by me...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … I don't know if I can do it.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: No. You'll have to do it. If you say you can't do it, I might kill you.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Let's make it happen.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … … … I'll try my best.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: %s. I don't feel like it, but I think I need your help. Could you please help me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s complete the quest.)

steps.name: Preparation work (1)
steps.objective: You must collect 10 each of <Mariposa's Butterfly Crystal> from the "Jade Forest" and <Weitl's Gem Crystal> and <Golem's Gem Crystal> from the "Quartz Cave".

steps.name: Preparation work (2)
steps.objective: You must collect 40 <Black Slime> from the [Demon-Possessed Soul], [Demon-Infected Resentment], and [Maturated Soul Fragments] in the "Quartz Cave".

steps.name: Artifact Destruction (1)
steps.objective: You must help Calone destroy the artifact.

steps.name: Artifact Destruction (2)
steps.objective: You must defeat [Petit Degos] and obtain <Petit Degos' Horn>.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: From now on, we will use the materials we received from %s to bring out the power of Degos sealed in the artifact.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Parmilla, wouldn't it be better for you to go somewhere else?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I can keep my body healthy, so don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmilla's eyes are full of determination. Calone sighed softly and then continued.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Here's the plan: We will use these jewels containing the power of Mirgandia to manipulate the artifact's magic circuit. The structure of the circuit will be overturned and the flow of power will reverse, bringing out the power of the sealed Degos.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: When that happens, these newly engraved magic circuits will materialize that power. Next, %s, you have to destroy the power of the materialized Degoth.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That role is mine...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: No. Parmilla. The materialized magical power will be much more powerful. It may not end up as a loss of consciousness like last time.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I don't know why, but it's safer to leave it to %s, who is completely unaffected by that power.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: If something goes wrong for you in this situation... I no longer have the dignity to look at former mercenary members.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmilla must have been convinced by Calone's words, reluctantly nodding her head and stepping back.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...So %s, do you understand what you have to do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I answer?)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Your role is most important. If you make a mistake...if you make a mistake, it can put us all at risk.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Please do not betray my trust.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: So let's get started.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Calone started touching the artifact here and there.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I couldn't understand what was going on, so I decided to wait patiently with Parmilla.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I wonder how much time has passed... Calone looked back.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Okay, that's it. Now to get this working…

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Calone pushed the last piece of jewelry in his hand into the groove of the artifact.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Get ready! %s!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But nothing happened.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … ?! That can't be... !

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Calone began tinkering with the artifact again, but soon looked resigned.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … failure… I think I did it.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I feel like this is already beyond what I can handle. … I'm really sorry.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I don’t want to hear such irresponsible talk!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (First, let’s complete the quest from Calone.)

choices.text: 2. I don't know what you're talking about.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Did you just forget?... Are you really an idiot?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Just catch the materialized Degoth when it pops out! Even an idiot would understand this much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Parmilla and Calone are looking at each other with surprised rabbit eyes.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: %s!! Where have you been?!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Are you okay?? I was surprised when it suddenly disappeared!! I was worried!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It was explained to the two people that Petit Degos appeared near the artifact and that it was defeated.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Probably the two people did not see Petit Degos.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: If %s's explanation is true, the task of materializing the power of Degos sealed in the artifact appears to have been successful.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Why was it only visible to you? It's hard for me to explain too. Has the power of magic distorted space at all?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: In any case, I think that if it was materialized with such an imperfect appearance, this artifact would not be completely complete.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Moreover, Degos was also killed... This is truly a disaster.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So now he's back to normal?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Since the link between the remaining thoughts and the artifact has been severed, I think things will improve with Peakman's medicine. I don't know how long it will take... … .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It doesn't matter how long it takes, as long as I can definitely get back to normal.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Now, two people. Now let's go back to the garrison. The entrance here will now be closed.

steps.name: Breaking up is the beginning of another meeting
steps.objective: You must return to Parmilla at “Oscuras Temporary Garrison.”

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Is this the winning bid? It was hectic, but somehow it seems to have been completed.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, thank you so much for your help. You had a lot of trouble coming all this far because of me, right? I will never forget this favor. and…

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: … Thank you, Calone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: (shudder)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: There is no need to be so cautious. really… I just want to be truly grateful.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: For giving us back Gron.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Hmm… Hmm. you're welcome. On the contrary, I am in a position where I have to apologize to Oscuras.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Even though I didn't commit it myself, I brought it upon myself, so it's natural for me to fulfill my responsibility to the end.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I am now planning to return to my home country and negotiate in person.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes?! No!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Oh, don't worry. We will handle the payment of remuneration neatly.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: No! That's not the problem!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: If you go back there, you might die!!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … Yes, maybe. However, if that is the result of the research I pursued, I think that is also inevitable.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ugh… Ugh… Ah, really!!!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Why are there so many tactless idiots around me?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes, if I die and say I will take responsibility for it, is that the end? All you can do is run away for your own peace of mind!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: If you really think you did something wrong and want to take responsibility, you have to look at reality and choose the most useful method!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … I thought this was the most reasonable method for now...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: May I make a suggestion, Calone?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Join our mercenary group.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … … … yes?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Don't report anything to the empire like this, but join our mercenary group.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: And they falsely report that the exploration is progressing safely. For example, a spy?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Then you don't have to die, we don't have to lose our jobs, and we can keep making money! … And they won't let you do whatever they want.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It’s a win-win for both sides♬

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … Parmilla, are you serious?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Today's enemy is tomorrow's friend.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I think this is a very reasonable method, what do you think?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Calone, who looked worried for a moment, smiled and held the hand that Parmilla held out.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … Well then, shall we try to join temporarily?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Huh? Such a high profile for a newbie~? Oh my, I'm already starting to regret the invitation to join~

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Heh… Well then, thank you. heartbreak.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: “Nim,” should I add it?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Ugh… … See, you have a nicer personality than you look. heartbreak… … sir.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ahahahaha. Then shall we go say hello to the kids?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Will Varmun be happy that he can finally become friends with Calone?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Ugh…

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Calone started walking ahead at a snail's pace with a truly distressed expression on his face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As I was feeling sorry for my sagging shoulders, Parmilla spoke to me in a whisper.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Once again, I will greet you properly.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: As the leader of the Oscuras mercenary group, I am truly grateful to you.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hey, if it's okay, would you like to join our mercenary group?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I was grateful, but decided to decline.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yeah. For some reason, I thought they would reject it, but... Still, it's a pity.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Then I'll make you an honorary member, so you can come visit anytime?
